verdict.rationale: Telemetry opt-out is a fair question for an agent framework with a CLI and dev UI, but the evidence pack never documents any telemetry, usage tracking, or a way to disable it. The offline-deployment option (docs-7) and token-usage tracking (docs-12) are adjacent features, not an opt-out control.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
